@meta.name: English
@meta.note: Textos de py-installer: instalador (inst.*), desinstalador (uninst.*), página de descarga (page.*) y actualizador (upd.*).

inst.not_installed: {app} does not seem to be installed.
inst.intro1: It installs for your user only. Nothing else is needed: no Python and no administrator rights.
inst.intro2: The first time it downloads Python and the libraries; it may take a couple of minutes.
inst.low_space: warning: only about {mb} MB free on drive {drive}:. To install on another drive: close this, run "set {var}=D:\{folder}" in a command window and then the installer from there.
inst.no_uv_exe: The downloaded uv file does not contain uv.exe.
inst.try.fresh: a new folder and Windows certificates
inst.try.slow: a short folder and a slow connection
inst.uv_no_python: uv could not download Python; trying a direct download...
inst.py_none_release: there is no Python {ver} for Windows in the latest published release
inst.no_python_exe: the downloaded file does not contain python.exe
inst.py_no_start: the downloaded Python does not start
inst.no_python: Could not get Python {ver}. It may be Windows Defender (controlled folder access) or another antivirus deleting files while they are unpacked, or a proxy or firewall blocking GitHub. Try pausing the antivirus for a few minutes and run the installer again. Last messages: {tail}
inst.no_tk: The downloaded Python does not have a working tkinter (Tcl/Tk). Run the installer again; if it still fails, report it at {url}
inst.no_icon: could not download the icon (continuing without it)
inst.no_data: could not download the initial data (skipped): {error}
inst.step.install: Installing the program and its libraries
inst.venv_fail: could not create the Python environment: {tail}
inst.extra_fail: {label}: {error}. You can download it yourself from {url} and copy {files} to "{dir}"; then run the installer again.
inst.hint_vc: The 'Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable' component is missing. Install it from https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe and open {app} from the Start menu.
inst.hint_tk: This is usually a half-built Python environment. Run the installer again (delete the folder '{dir}' first if it keeps failing).
inst.libs_broken: {app} has been installed, but its libraries do not load on this computer, so it will not open yet.
inst.find_start: You will find it in the Start menu.
inst.find_start_desktop: You will find it in the Start menu and on the desktop.
inst.choose_default: To always open {exts} files with {app}: right-click one > Open with > Choose another app > {app} > "Always use this app".
inst.failed: The installation could not be completed:
inst.failed_retry: You can run the installer again: it will continue where it left off.
inst.dl_timeout: the download did not finish in {s}s (very slow or stuck connection)
inst.dl_failed: Could not download {url} ({error}). Check your internet connection.
uninst.ask_data:
Also delete your data and settings?

If you say no, they are kept in case you install it again.
page.title: {app} — download
page.only_for: For now there is an installer for: {list}.
page.how.windows: Open the downloaded file. If Windows warns you ("Windows protected your PC"), click "More info" and "Run anyway".
page.how.macos: Unzip it and open "{file}" with right-click > Open (macOS asks for it this way the first time).
page.footer: It installs for your user only, without administrator rights and without installing Python first. Running the installer again updates the program.
upd.title: Updates
upd.auto: Tell me when I open the program if there is a new version
upd.auto_apply: Update automatically on open, without asking (a copy is kept in case you want to go back)
upd.watch: Watch silently, no notices: update as soon as a new version is published
upd.watch_help: While the program is open it checks now and then; if there is a new version it installs it and restarts by itself when you are not doing anything. This box is shown with {keys}.
upd.back: Go back to the previous version
upd.state.older: Your version is newer than the published one.
upd.state.diverged: Your copy does not match the published one (you can replace it with the published one).
upd.restart_failed:
The update is installed, but the program could not restart by itself.
Close {app} and open it again.

({error})
upd.check_failed:
Could not check: {error}
Check your connection and try again.
upd.apply_failed:
Could not finish: {error}
Nothing has been changed.
upd.installed_busy: Installed. {app} will restart as soon as it finishes what it is doing.
upd.installed: Done. The program restarts in a few seconds…
upd.rollback_q: Go back to the previous version and restart {app}?
upd.rolled_back: Done. The program restarts in a few seconds…
upd.not_installed: This program was not installed with its installer: it cannot update itself.
upd.ask.title: There is a new version of {app} ({v}).
upd.ask.text: Download and install it now? A copy of the current version is kept and the program restarts; your data is not touched.
upd.ask.dont: Don't ask again on open (I'd rather update by hand)
upd.err.not_installed: this program was not installed with py-installer (it is not known where to update from)
upd.err.hash: {file}: the download does not match the published fingerprint (cancelled; if it was just published, try again in a few minutes)
upd.err.frozen_apply: This installation is an executable: download the new installer from the program's page.
upd.err.no_write: There is no permission to write in the program's folder ({dir}).
upd.err.wrong_pack: The published file is not the one for the announced version (cancelled).
upd.err.frozen_back: This installation is an executable: the version cannot be changed from here.
upd.err.no_backup: There is no previous copy to go back to.
